Your condominium in good hands, with work done well.

Condominium maintenance and renovation in Rome

We support managers and owners in looking after buildings: facades, terraces, roofs, balconies and common areas. We follow every stage, from the inspection to the end of the works, with clear reports and quotes to bring to the owners' meeting.

Condominio Cramor

A single point of contact for the maintenance and enhancement of the condominium.

Condominio Cramor is the contractor a manager can trust with works on common areas: from the first assessment to completion, with organisation, clear times and documentation. We work in Rome and surroundings.

Our services

Everything a condominium needs, in one place
